semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Speech synthesis often refers to 'text-to-speech', where text inputs are converted to spoken words. They are essentially the same in focus and usage.
Speech synthesis utilizes generative models for creating audio outputs that emulate human speech. This domain directly involves creating synthetic speech.

parent_domains.justification: Speech synthesis is a part of the larger domain of speech processing, which includes all forms of processing related to speech signals.
Generative AI encompasses technologies and models like speech synthesis that generate content, including audio and speech.
Since speech is an audio signal, speech synthesis falls under the broader category of audio processing.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Speech processing is the closest parent since speech synthesis is directly related to processing and generating speech signals, making it a subdomain of speech processing.

child_domains.justification: Text-to-speech is a type of speech synthesis focused specifically on converting text input into spoken word. It is a more specific application of the broader concept of speech synthesis.

closest_child_domain.justification: Text-to-speech is the closest child domain because it focuses specifically on converting textual data to speech, which is the primary application of speech synthesis.

sibling_domains.justification: Like speech synthesis, speech recognition falls under speech processing. It involves interpreting spoken language rather than generating it.
While speech synthesis generates speech, speech enhancement improves the quality of a given speech signal. Both are closely tied to the broader domain of speech processing.
Focused on separating different speech signals from a mixture, this domain is related in that it deals with manipulating speech signals.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Speech recognition is the closest sibling domain since both deal directly with processing speech; one involves generating speech (synthesis), while the other involves interpreting it (recognition).

unrelated_domains.justification: This involves automating the creation of computer programs, unrelated to speech or audio processing.
Focuses on generating video content, which is unrelated to the audio/speech-specific domain of speech synthesis.
Involves generating code, a different domain from speech synthesis, which focuses on audio.
Converts text into images, unrelated to speech generation.
Related to hardware design rather than audio or speech.
Involves understanding and predicting language structure, which can be a component of NLP tasks but isn't directly involved in generating speech from text.
While it involves generating data, sequence generation can apply broadly to many fields beyond audio or speech, lacking the specific focus of speech synthesis.
